title: Building a 64-player shooter inspired by Tribes, Quake, & Unreal. Huge maps and fast movement at 1000 FPS.
author: hejyhej
selftext:
Releasing soon as free to play on steam for Linux, Mac, Windows.   
  
23 polished maps  
DM, TDM, CTF, Battle Royale, Defusal, and Shogun (large map territory capture)  
  
So far, two maps are really big battlefield-sized 

Using a custom 2026 Vulkan engine and netcode.

In-depth development blog at [https://shadowfrag.com/blog](https://shadowfrag.com/blog)

comments.author: mrpoopistan
comments.body:
I say his about seemingly every shooter I see on this sub, but . . .

There's no sense of peril or even challenge for the player. It's just a bunch of stuff happening and the player wins.

replies.author: hejyhej
replies.body: This is a multiplayer shooter. 1v1 me I will get 30 kills you will get zero. Then you can talk about challenge.

replies.author: mrpoopistan
replies.body:
The player has to feel like the game isn't easy. This video makes the game look easy.

No one cares how skilled you are at sucking your own dick in front of others. If the story is about you and how kewl you think you are, then just stop telling it because you suck at marketing if that's where your tiny brain is at.

replies.author: hejyhej
replies.body: My target audience are gamers who play on PC with mouse and keyboard and enjoy high skill technical movement and aim gameplay. In these communities frag movies showcasing technical movement and skill are a cultural staple.

comments.author: re-skob
comments.body: every aspect from the art, movement, weapon differentiation and feel, and level design looks worse than pretty much all of your inspirations or any other shooter that's come out since, but congrats on the frame rate

replies.author: hejyhej
replies.body: Its the same instagib railgun with different skins. You're being disingenuous in your post.

replies.author: re-skob
replies.body: All of what I said is my opinion, I dont need to argue bout it with you so take it as you want. I have no reason to be disingenuous, the game doesn't look good to me
